subject: CareCloud GCP private offer — packaging, decommit handling, and channel margin reconciliation
messages:
From: Emily Ramos <procurement@carecloudanalytics.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@ascend-distributor.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request — GCP private offer packaging + channel margin details

Hi Mateo / Ben,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the execs liked the latency profile on the Dedicated config. Procurement asked me to follow up with a concrete request for the GCP private offer so we can take it through our legal/finance review. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you share a SKU-level packaging proposal (reserved node vs metered components) and the list prices you plan to use on the GCP private offer? Our billing team needs the SKU IDs to validate their invoice routing.

2) We have a preferred distributor (Ascend) that will invoice us. We need the passback margin (the portion of your discount that flows to the distributor) spelled out — our procurement policy requires the exact distributor commission percentage and whether that reduces Redwood's net revenue or is treated as a third-party fee.

Attached is our internal procurement template and an initial SOW draft for scope. Can you get us a versioned package by COB Jan 20? Our target: sign-off by Jan 31.

Appreciate it —
Emily Ramos
Head of Procurement, CareCloud Analytics
procurement@carecloudanalytics.com

Attachments: CareCloud_PrivOffer_Request_20280118.pdf (pdf)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ramos <procurement@carecloudanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@ascend-distributor.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — GCP private offer packaging + channel margin details

Emily — thanks for the clear checklist. We'll put together the SKU mapping and a clear margin waterfall. A few clarifying points so we align: 

- Are you planning a 12-month committed node commitment or a 24-month? That changes the baseline list price we pull from the marketplace.
- Is Ascend acting as reseller only (invoice routing) or will they be entitled to a percentage of the contracted committed credit (i.e., distributor uplift)?

Tentative plan from our side: Ben and I will draft two packaging options — (A) Reserved-node-heavy (lower latency, higher baseline price) and (B) Metered-flex (lower commit, higher marginal cost) — each with the private-offer list prices and a recommended distributor passback percentage. We usually model distributor passback as an explicit third-party line (doesn't reduce the advertised private-offer list price, but we state Redwood net after passback) to keep bookkeeping clear for finance.

We'll target a first pass by end-of-day Jan 19 to give you time before your Jan 20 deadline.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ramos <procurement@carecloudanalytics.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@ascend-distributor.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — GCP private offer packaging + channel margin details

Emily, Mateo — putting numbers against the options below. Assumptions: 12-month commit, 8x reserved nodes equivalent for baseline throughput, Ascend as reseller + entitled distributor uplift.

Option A (Reserved-heavy):
- Marketplace list price (baseline): $120,000 / month
- Redwood recommended private-offer discount: 22% off list (net before passback: $93,600 / month)
- Distributor passback to Ascend: 10% of list (explicit line item, $12,000) — Redwood nets $81,600 (we show both lines on invoice)

Option B (Metered-flex):
- Baseline: $60,000 / month metered + burst
- Discount: 18% off list
- Distributor passback: 8% of list

Notes and negotiation levers:
- If CareCloud needs deeper list discount (25%+), we typically require either a 24-month commit or an upfront partial prepayment (3 months).
- Decommit / true-up language: we can structure a 90-day true-up window to protect Redwood from material undercommit — or include a short clawback on excess early termination.

I'll attach a draft SOW with the SKU mapping and a simple margin waterfall table to make it easy for your finance team.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_CareCloud_v1.docx (docx)
From: Diego Morales <diego.morales@carecloudanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Ramos <procurement@carecloudanalytics.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@ascend-distributor.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jan 2028 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — GCP private offer packaging + channel margin details

Ben / Mateo,

Thanks for the breakdown — helpful. A couple of follow-ups from finance: 

1) CareCloud's FP&A is pushing for a 25% vendor discount to hit our internal TCO targets. We'll accept the 12-month commitment if Redwood can meet 25% off listed private-offer pricing on Option A, with a formal decommit true-up (90 days) and no upfront prepayment.

2) On distributor passback: Ascend is asking for 12% of list (they handle billing and certain local tax flows). We need confirmation whether that 12% would be treated as a third-party reseller fee (invoice shows list, discount, reseller fee), or if Redwood will treat it as a reduction to your net. We prefer the third-party fee line for transparency.

3) Can Redwood provide the GCP SKU IDs and a sample invoice stub that shows the waterfall (list, discount, reseller passback, Redwood net)? That will accelerate procurement validation.

Can you confirm by EOD Jan 24?

Diego Morales
Sr. Financial Analyst, CareCloud Analytics

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Diego Morales <diego.morales@carecloudanalytics.com>, Emily Ramos <procurement@carecloudanalytics.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@ascend-distributor.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jan 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — GCP private offer packaging + channel margin details

Diego / Emily — looping in from VP Sales to finalize. Appreciate the clarity on numbers. Quick answers and next steps: 

- We can accommodate 25% off list for Option A at a 12-month commit, conditional on accepting a 90-day true-up (standard) and a one-time onboarding credit reversal if CareCloud terminates within the first 6 months. This preserves the economics for Redwood while meeting your TCO target.

- Distributor passback: we will present the passback as an explicit third-party reseller fee line (12% of list to Ascend). The private-offer list price will remain the published number; the invoice will show (1) list, (2) Redwood discount, (3) Ascend reseller fee, (4) Redwood net. Finance will have full traceability.

- Action items: Ben to send SKU IDs + sample invoice stub (by COB Jan 25). Mateo to update the SOW and produce a versioned MOU that reflects the conditional concession. I will approve the MOU for signature once Ben confirms the finance stub.

We are attaching a revised MOU for your review. If this looks good, we'll route DocuSign and aim to have countersigned copies by Jan 31.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: MOU_revised_CareCloud_20280124.pdf (pdf)
